description: Issue an invoice that references an existing proforma, so the two are linked in Oblio. Client, lines and total are the proforma's; nothing is retyped. The proforma is read first and returned as fromProforma, and the new invoice's total is held to it. Moves money or makes a legal document: the client asks the user to approve each call.

idempotency_key.description: Oblio refuses a second document with the same key. Leave it out: the key is then derived from the document's content and issue date, so an identical retry cannot issue twice. Give one only to issue a second, deliberately identical document the same day, or to retry with the key an outcome_unknown failure reported.

invoice_series.description: The INVOICE series to issue into, from list_series.

proforma_number.description: The document number as text, without its series: "0042" is not 42.

proforma_series.description: The document's series, exactly as list_series shows it.

name: invoice_from_proforma
title: Invoice an existing proforma
